## Homework

Work on your poster for the Theory Methods Conference.
You can do so in a program like:

* Google Slides or PowerPoint (really for making slides, but whatever)
* Adobe Illustrator, PhotoShop, or GIMP (free)
* You can even use R, for example, using [this template](https://github.com/mpimet/quarto)

Make a poster to present *the current state of your work* on theory specification for this course.
It does not matter how far along you are - just present your work in a compelling manner.
Put any doubts, questions, or limitations that have come up during your work on the poster, to stimulate discussion with your audience.

For guidance on what to cover on your poster, see the [Theory Paper Format](https://osf.io/d3jmw/files/g8jz2). This will also be your guidance for the final paper for this course.

Since you are only at the beginning of the process of specifying a full theory, focus on the following sections of the Theory Paper Format:

1. Introduction and Problem Definition
2. Conceptual Outline
3. Theory Specification, inasfar as you already have one - this can also be in draft stage.
5.Optional: Applied Example or Case Study
6. Discussion

Note that a poster should have *very little written text*.
Create a separate block for each section, with bullet points totalling ~50-80 words per section.
Use images instead of text when you can.
